# Karst Agency

> Karst Agency helps shops and service companies hand the typing, chasing, and slow follow-up to AI, so their people spend the day on the work they're good at. Based in London, Kentucky.

## What we do

- We fix the everyday leaks: leads answered too late, quotes that take days, follow-up that only happens when somebody remembers, and busywork that eats the team's week.
- Answer every lead fast, even after hours, with nothing left unworked in an inbox.
- Get quotes out while they're still warm, with the information pulled together and the quote drafted.
- Hand the typing, copying, chasing, and scheduling over to systems instead of people.

## Who it is for

- Shops and service companies that run lean: industrial and manufacturing suppliers, and facility services companies.
- Owners who run good businesses and are not technical, and don't want to be.
- Not for: businesses with no customers yet, anyone who already knows which tool they want to buy, or anyone who needs it fixed this week.

## How it starts

- A 15-minute discovery call about the business and where the time goes. No pitch. If we can't help, we say so on the call.
- Then a paid working session inside the business. The owner leaves with one page, in plain words: where the time is going, what we'd fix first, and what it would take. The page is theirs to keep whether or not we work together.
- Then we build it, only if it's worth doing. The price is in writing before anything starts and doesn't change. No hourly billing.
- Pricing is quoted in conversation and in writing before any step starts. It is not published on this site.

## Straight with you

- We're a new firm. Before any work starts, we agree in plain writing what it's supposed to change. When it's done, we show whether it did.
